module.name: Data adapters
navigation.label: Data adapters
navigation.description: Pull records from other systems and push lists back out
page.title: Data adapters
page.description: The adapters modules declare to pull records from another system into this workspace or push a list out to it. Bind a connector instance, check the mapping with a dry run, then run on demand or on a schedule.
target.unavailableHint: The import port or list this adapter uses is not registered, so it cannot be enabled, previewed or run.
table.title: Adapters
table.caption: Data adapters declared by the modules of this workspace
table.note: Every call leaves through the bound connector instance and needs its consent for workflows.
empty.title: No adapters declared
empty.hint: A module declares adapters in its specification; they appear here once it is enabled.
denied.title: No access to data adapters
denied.hint: Reading data adapters needs the adapters.runs.read permission.
action.runNowDisabled: Enable the adapter before running it.
form.instanceHelp: An instance of the {connector} connector. Without one, the recorded fixture answers outside production.
form.cronHelp: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week, in the workspace time zone.
form.consentHint: This instance does not consent to workflows, so a run will fail until an owner allows it on the Connectors screen.
mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.sourceHint: Each rule writes one field of the import port from the service record.
mapping.sinkHint: Each rule writes one field of the pushed record from a list column.
mapping.formatHelp: trim, lower, upper, integer, decimal, boolean, iso-date or date:DD.MM.YYYY
dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Reads the first page, maps it with the rules above and validates it. Nothing is written.
dryRun.caption: {shown} of {read} records of the first page
dryRun.empty.title: The first page is empty
runs.title: Runs
runs.caption: Runs of this adapter, newest first
runs.empty.title: No runs yet
runs.empty.hint: Runs started now or by the schedule appear here.
rows.title: Rows
rows.caption: The outcome of every record of the run
rows.empty.title: No rows
rows.empty.hint: This run handled no records, or their outcomes are past retention.
error.load: Could not load the data adapters.
error.instances: Could not load the connector instances.
error.code.ADAPTER_CALL_RATE_LIMITED: The service asked to slow down.
error.code.ADAPTER_CALL_REFUSED: Connectors refused the call; check the instance, its hosts and its credential.
error.code.ADAPTER_CALL_TIMEOUT: The service did not answer in time.
error.code.ADAPTER_CONNECTORS_UNAVAILABL: Connectors is not available in this deployment.
error.code.ADAPTER_CONSENT_MISSING: The connector instance does not consent to workflows.
error.code.ADAPTER_CURSOR_INVALID: The service answered a next page cursor that cannot be used.
error.code.ADAPTER_CURSOR_STALLED: The service answered the same page cursor again.
error.code.ADAPTER_LIST_FAILED: The list could not answer a page.
error.code.ADAPTER_LIST_FORBIDDEN: The account the run acts for may not read the list.
error.code.ADAPTER_PAGES_EXCEEDED: The run read its maximum of pages; resume it to go on.
error.code.ADAPTER_PAGE_TOO_LARGE: A page carried more records than a run accepts.
error.code.ADAPTER_PORT_FAILED: The import port refused the batch.
error.code.ADAPTER_PORT_FORBIDDEN: The account the run acts for may not write through the import port.
error.code.ADAPTER_PRINCIPAL_FORBIDDEN: The account the run acts for no longer manages adapters.
error.code.ADAPTER_PRINCIPAL_UNAVAILABLE: The account the run acts for is no longer an active member.
error.code.ADAPTER_RECORDED_CALL_MISSING: The recorded fixture holds no answer for this call.
error.code.ADAPTER_REGISTRATION_INVALID: A module declared an adapter this platform cannot accept.
error.code.ADAPTER_REGISTRY_SEALED: Adapters are registered while the platform starts.
error.code.ADAPTER_RESPONSE_INVALID: The service answer carries no records where the adapter expects them.
error.code.ADAPTER_RUN_ACTIVE: A run of this adapter is already queued or running.
error.code.ADAPTER_RUN_FAILED: The run stopped on an unexpected error.
error.code.ADAPTER_RUN_NOT_ACTIVE: Only a queued or running run can be cancelled.
error.code.ADAPTER_RUN_NOT_FOUND: That run does not exist in this workspace.
error.code.ADAPTER_RUN_NOT_RESUMABLE: Only the most recent failed or cancelled run with a stored cursor can be resumed.
error.code.ADAPTER_SCHEDULE_INVALID: The schedule is not a five-field cron.
error.code.ADAPTER_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: The import port or list of this adapter is not registered.
error.code.MAPPING_FORMAT_INVALID: The value does not parse with the rule's format.
error.code.MAPPING_INVALID: The mapping does not fit the port or the list.
error.code.MAPPING_LOOKUP_UNMATCHED: The lookup table holds no entry for the value.
error.code.MAPPING_VALUE_INVALID: The value is not text, a number or a yes or no, or it is too long.
